card.name: Words just before blood-count or leukemia terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word starts right before a blood-cell or cancer term, such as 'effect on the granulocytes', 'acute and chronic leukemia', or 'neut' before 'ropenia'. Also fires on some other words that precede a regulatory or medical phrase.

modes.label: Before white-cell terms
modes.description: A linking word or word start sits just before granulocytes, neutropenia, neutrophils or leukemia.
modes.example: Rarely, a reversible reduction of the white blood cell count with a primary effect<< on>> the granulocytes has been seen.

modes.label: Before 'major depressive disorder'
modes.description: The word 'for' after antidepressants in boxed-warning text.
modes.example: Increased risk of suicidal thinking and behavior in children, adolescents, and young adults taking antidepressants<< for>> major depressive disorder and other psychiatric disorders.

modes.label: Other scattered cases
modes.description: A number, percent sign or 'with' before a regulatory or lab term.
modes.example: Warren is complying<< with>> new federal meal program guidelines that require them
